analysis: The gated-conv2 candidate achieved validation HR@10=0.665 at epoch 15 of 35, improving over the cited 0.645 baseline by 0.020 (four additional hits across 200 users). It tied the recorded best of 0.665, so it did not meet the strict retention criterion of exceeding that score. Content-dependent filtering is a plausible explanation for the gain, but this single seeded comparison does not establish the mechanism. No test metrics were consulted.
code_summary: NextItNet with 64 hidden units, eight causal residual blocks, kernel size 3, and dilations [1,2,4,8] repeated twice. Each block retains gated mixing of dense local and dilated convolutions, then applies a doubled-channel dilated conv2 with tanh(value) × sigmoid(gate_logits). Gate-half biases initialize to 1.0; learned per-channel residual scales initialize to 0.1. Layer normalization, GELU, dropout 0.2, padding masks, position-free tied item embeddings, and the zero-initialized causal short-convolution branch are preserved. Interfaces, hyperparameters, and frozen host responsibilities remain unchanged.
